limitations: Diagnostic phases include full sink verification; batch production includes I/O, decoding and column assembly, not a sampled function profile
Instant per batch adds instrumentation overhead; no subtraction or count-only performance claim
Small profiles are not independent oversized acceptance or parallel speedup qualification

focused_diagnostics.note: Focused filters are development diagnostics; full reader suites have no ignored or filtered tests.

findings.issue: Stop outside wait registration could lose a wakeup and hang joins
findings.disposition: Signal gate serializes predicate-to-wait registration with all notifications; fixed state-to-gate lock order; deterministic regression for stop between predicate and wait.

findings.issue: Estimated bulk admission could spawn before actual decoder/batch allocations
findings.disposition: Prepare real initial cursors, decoders, buffers and fixed slot/join capacities before any spawn. Later tasks prepare before dispatch; root denial is sticky.

findings.issue: A retained cancellation handle could retain bulk queues after cursor drop
findings.disposition: Separate small charged signal ownership from shared worker state; regression checks root restoration with a surviving handle.

findings.issue: Fallible handle publication after successful spawn could detach a thread
findings.disposition: Check admitted handle capacity before each spawn; publication uses already allocated Vec capacity; constructor failures stop and join every published handle.

findings.issue: Join diagnostics could overwrite original cleanup errors
findings.disposition: Bounded cleanup aggregation preserves primary IO plus initial cleanup denial and injected join panic; partial-spawn test verifies joined worker count and root restoration.

findings.issue: Limit completion could acknowledge output before all worker errors/source changes are known
findings.disposition: Truncate every exposed column, stop/join before final acknowledgment, check source again after joins for limit and full completion; regression preserves acknowledged progress.

findings.issue: A late cancellation handle could retroactively invalidate terminal completion
findings.disposition: Serialize the first stop under the signal gate; later requests cannot change terminal completion. Zero/empty and limit/reuse integration regressions cover this.

findings.issue: Cancellation cannot interrupt synchronous source IO
findings.disposition: Document no wall-clock bound; controlled blocked-read test proves worker remains owned and joined only after read release.
Report per-worker raw work and one Reader aggregate IO delta; never sum worker IO deltas.

findings.issue: Native all-feature commands timed out on earlier Windows/macOS Intel attempts with incomplete diagnostic tails
findings.disposition: Keep all failures and unknown causes; preserve 180-second command guards and assertions. Add bounded TimeoutExpired capture and separate CI annotations. Identical runtime sources pass all four platforms on diagnostic revision 55188ae; this does not establish a universal runtime bound.

limits: Opt-in existing index feature only; explicit validated source/symbol owner required. No automatic build/open/planner or silent serial retry.
Budget reduction is explicit and only before spawn for BudgetTooSmall. A one-worker admission is an actual worker.
Initial stacks/control/codecs/batches/checkpoints/slots share one root; later preparation may fail if other same-Reader allocations consume freed memory.
Fixed small standard Arc/thread allocations retain Rust allocator-abort behavior. Library accounting is not universal VM/RSS accounting.
Capped functional diagnostics cover two/four workers on Linux x86_64, not eight workers, other OS containment, independently oversized inputs or general speedup.
Synchronous OS reads are not forcibly interruptible. Source length/mtime assumptions remain; no competing-writer CAS.
Active work counters are completed-step snapshots; final counts include speculation and rejected rows. Speculative observed failures remain fatal beyond an eventual prefix.
Task 039 automatic policy and task 040 performance/oversized acceptance remain pending. No M6 release or independent review is claimed.
next_task: 039 after task 038 review: measured observable execution policy
